uid=$(id -u nodeapp)
cat > /etc/systemd/system/node-hello.service <<NODEAPP_UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Rootless Podman Node.js hello-world service
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target user@${uid}.service

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=all
User=nodeapp
Group=nodeapp
Environment=HOME=/home/nodeapp
Environment=XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/${uid}
Environment=DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/${uid}/bus
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --name node-hello --replace --rm --pull=never --sdnotify=conmon --publish 0.0.0.0:8080:8080 localhost/node-hello:latest
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman stop --ignore --time 10 node-hello
ExecStopPost=-/usr/bin/podman rm --force --ignore node-hello
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
TimeoutStartSec=90
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=none

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

restorecon /etc/systemd/system/node-hello.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/node-hello.service

env_cmd="HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/${uid} DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/${uid}/bus"

http_code=$(curl --silent --show-error --output /tmp/node-hello-body --write-out '%{http_code}' "http://${NODE_IP}:8080/")

printf 'body_bytes='; wc -c < /tmp/node-hello-body
if printf 'Hello, world!' | cmp -s - /tmp/node-hello-body; then printf 'body_exact=yes\n'; else printf 'body_exact=no\n'; exit 1; fi
printf 'body='; cat /tmp/node-hello-body; printf '\n'
printf 'body_hex='; od -An -tx1 -v /tmp/node-hello-body | tr -d ' \n'; printf '\n'
test "$http_code" = 200
